sentences.text: Mr. Mahammud Mahmud ... for the petitioners.

The complainant opposite party herein initiated the instant proceeding against three accused persons including the present two petitioners under section 448/323/506/420/34 of the Indian Penal Code alleging that the accused no. 1, Chandi Charan Roy, who acquired the property by way of a deed of partition had sold the same to one Sanjay Guchait by virtue of a registered deed of sale on 28th March, 2014 for a consideration of Rs. 2,97,000/-, which was a valid and legal transfer.

Thereafter said accused no. 1, Chandi Charan Roy in collusion with the present petitioners, who are accused nos., 2 and 3 sold the property to the accused no. 2/petitioner no. 1 herein Smt. Soma Roy claiming that the petitioners father acquired the said property through deed of partition.

Learned counsel for the petitioners submits that the allegation made in the written complaint is purely in connection with a civil dispute and the content of the FIR does not disclose any criminal offence.
The proceeding has been initiated only to harass them and if it is allowed to be continued it will be mere abuse of the process of the court.
Having heard learned counsel appearing on behalf of the petitioners, the application is admitted.

Petitioners are directed to serve a copy of application upon the opposite party no. 1 through the office of learned Public Prosecutor, High Court, Calcutta, and opposite party no. 2 through speed post intimating next date of hearing and to file affidavit of service on the returnable date.
Let the matter be listed on 24th November, 2025 under the heading "Contested Application".
(Dr. Ajoy Kumar Mukherjee, J.)
